title: Deploy with gated verification and post-deploy chain check
summary: A change is gated against scorecard + invariant catalog + sensor evidence before deploy, then post-deploy verifies that the deployed runtime's audit-chain head matches the artifact-of-record. Drift triggers rollback recommendation.
preconditions: Scorecard JSON exists at the configured path
Artifact-of-record SHA known; deployment target reachable

steps.expected_outcome: REL-NNNN record persisted with verdict `pass` | `block` | `review` | `inconclusive`; reasons listed when not pass

steps.action: On verdict=pass, proceed with deploy (external to DEVAI: docker push, k8s apply, etc.)
steps.expected_outcome: Artifact reaches the target environment; the deployment system reports success
alternative_paths: On verdict=block, do not deploy; investigate the reasons (often: invariant catalog empty, scorecard red, sensor readings stale)
On verdict=review, route to human for sign-off before deploy

steps.action: After deploy, read the deployed runtime's audit-chain head (via runtime API or operator interface) and run `devai release postdeploy verify --artifact <ref> --artifact-chain-head <sha-of-record> --audit-chain-head <observed-sha>`
steps.expected_outcome: REL-NNNN+1 records the comparison; verdict=pass when heads match, verdict=block + rollback_recommended=true when they diverge

steps.action: On rollback_recommended, execute the rollback (revert deploy or roll forward with fix); do not leave the divergence unaddressed
steps.expected_outcome: Runtime audit chain re-aligns with the artifact-of-record; or a new artifact is built and re-gated

postconditions: At least two REL-NNNN records exist for the deploy event: one gate decision, one post-deploy verification
If `rollback_recommended` was true, an explicit rollback action was taken (not silently ignored)

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every `release *` action persists a release-control record under .devai/state/releases/; the record is schema-valid.
When the gate verdict is `block`, deploy MUST NOT proceed. (Operationally enforced — no current CI mechanism prevents it, see docs/arch/known-tech-debt.md for the records-vs-detectors gap.)
